1	# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)
4	
5	**Created**: 2026-10-12
6	
7	**Status**: Draft
8	
9	**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."
10	
11	## Clarifications
12	
13	### Session 2026-10-12
14	
15	- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
16	- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
17	- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
18	
19	## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*
20	
21	### User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1)
22	
23	A user wants to quickly note something in words. They tap "+" on Home/Chat, the Insertion Modal opens on its "Texto" tab, they write freely in the text field, and tap "Salvar". The modal closes and the note now exists as one of their journal entries.
24	
25	**Why this priority**: The simplest and fully self-contained of the three capture paths — it has no dependency on recognition of any kind, so it is the first thing that must work end to end.
26	
27	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by tapping "+", typing text into the Texto tab, tapping "Salvar", and confirming a new entry with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.
28	
29	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
30	
31	1. **Given** Home/Chat is open, **When** the user taps "+", **Then** the Insertion Modal opens as an overlay on top of Home/Chat (which stays in place underneath), defaulted to the "Texto" tab with an empty field.
32	2. **Given** the Texto tab with text typed into the field, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** a new journal entry is created with that text as its content and origin "manual", and the modal closes, returning to Home/Chat.
33	3. **Given** the Texto tab with an empty field, **When** the user looks at "Salvar", **Then** the action is unavailable (disabled), so an empty entry can never be created.
34	
35	---
36	
37	### User Story 2 - Recording a journal entry as audio (Priority: P1)
38	
39	A user prefers to speak rather than type. They tap "+", switch to the "Áudio" tab, and recording begins with a visible waveform and timer. They tap stop, and after a brief moment the spoken content is saved as a journal entry just like a written one.
40	
41	**Why this priority**: Voice capture is one of the two microphone/camera-dependent paths and, together with Story 1, establishes that every modality converges on the same entry format — the central acceptance criterion of this unit.
42	
43	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Áudio tab, recording a short spoken note, stopping the recording, confirming Save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from what was spoken.
44	
45	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
46	
47	1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Áudio" tab, **Then** recording starts immediately, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running mm:ss timer.
48	2. **Given** an active recording, **When** the user taps stop, **Then** the recording ends and the system automatically transcribes it and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "audio" and the transcribed text as its content.
49	3. **Given** a completed audio capture that is being transcribed and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
50	4. **Given** transcription or the save itself fails (e.g., inaudible recording, network timeout), **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to re-record, as long as the captured audio is still held locally.
51	
52	---
53	
54	### User Story 3 - Capturing a journal entry from a photo (Priority: P2)
55	
56	A user has something written down on paper, a receipt, or a whiteboard. They tap "+", switch to the "Foto" tab, choose "Câmera" or "Galeria", and the text in the image becomes a journal entry.
57	
58	**Why this priority**: Mirrors Story 2's recognition pipeline for a second input type; ordered after audio because the text-recognition concern it shares with Story 2 is already established there.
59	
60	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Foto tab, choosing "Câmera" or "Galeria" to supply an image containing legible text, confirming the save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
61	
62	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
63	
64	1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Foto" tab, **Then** two options are shown — "Câmera" and "Galeria" — with no image selected yet.
65	2. **Given** the user picks "Câmera" or "Galeria" and supplies an image, **When** that image is provided, **Then** the system automatically extracts its text and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
66	3. **Given** a completed photo capture that is being recognized and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
67	4. **Given** text recognition or the save itself fails, **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to recapture the image, as long as it is still held locally.
68	
69	---
70	
71	### User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)
72	
73	A user starts writing, recording, or photographing, changes their mind, and backs out. Nothing about that attempt is saved anywhere.
74	
75	**Why this priority**: A safety property that applies across all three modalities rather than a feature of its own; depends on Stories 1–3 already existing to have something to abandon.
76	
77	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by starting each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the camera/gallery picker) and closing the modal or navigating away before tapping Salvar, then confirming no new entry was created in any case.
78	
79	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
80	
81	1. **Given** partially typed text in the Texto tab, **When** the user closes the modal without tapping "Salvar", **Then** no entry is created and the draft text is discarded.
82	2. **Given** an in-progress audio recording, **When** the user closes the modal or stops without confirming save, **Then** no entry is created and no partially-recorded audio is persisted as an entry.
83	3. **Given** the Foto tab's camera/gallery picker is open, **When** the user cancels it without completing a capture, **Then** no entry is created.
84	
85	---
86	
87	### Edge Cases
88	
89	- Microphone or camera permission is denied at the OS level: the respective tab shows an explanatory message in place of the recording/capture controls, instead of silently failing or crashing.
90	- The user switches tabs while a recording is in progress: the in-progress recording is discarded (same outcome as closing the modal), since no partial entry may survive regardless of which tab is active afterward.
91	- The app is backgrounded or killed while a capture is in progress and unsaved, **or while it is stopped/captured and awaiting retry after a recognition or save failure**: nothing is lost that mattered, because nothing was persisted yet — the captured audio/image and any pending retry state exist only in memory for the current app session. On return (after a mere backgrounding, the modal resumes normally; after a kill, the modal reopens to its default empty state), and if the content was lost to a process kill, the user must recapture rather than retry.
92	- Transcription or OCR succeeds technically but returns no usable text (e.g., silence, a blank or illegible image): Save fails with a clear message rather than creating an empty or near-empty entry. A `low`-confidence OCR result that still contains text is not treated as a failure — confidence-based quality gating is out of scope for this unit (reserved for RF02) — so Save proceeds normally with whatever text was recognized.
93	- The device is offline when the user taps "Salvar": the save is blocked immediately with a clear message, without attempting a network call that cannot succeed, consistent with this product's cloud-only architecture (no offline writes).
94	- The user double-taps "Salvar": only one entry is ever created per confirmed capture, never duplicates.
95	
96	## Requirements *(mandatory)*
97	
98	### Functional Requirements
99	
100	- **FR-001**: The system MUST provide an Insertion Modal, opened by the "+" button on Home/Chat, shown as an overlay above Home/Chat (with a darkened scrim) without discarding or navigating away from Home/Chat's state underneath.
101	- **FR-002**: The Insertion Modal MUST present exactly three capture modes as tabs — "Texto", "Áudio", "Foto" — with the active tab visually distinguished, and MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened.
102	- **FR-003**: The "Texto" tab MUST provide a free multiline text field and a "Salvar" action that is unavailable while the field is empty.
103	- **FR-004**: The "Áudio" tab MUST start real-time audio recording as soon as it becomes active, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running timer, matching the "Gravando" state.
104	- **FR-005**: The "Foto" tab MUST offer the user a choice between the device camera and the photo gallery to supply a single image, matching the "Captura" state.
105	- **FR-006**: Confirming Save on any modality MUST result in exactly one persisted journal entry, created through the entry-creation endpoint, carrying the content appropriate to that modality and the correct origin (`manual` for text, `audio` for audio, `photo` for photo) — never a chat message. This guarantee MUST hold even if the user triggers Save/stop/picker-confirm more than once in quick succession for the same capture (e.g., a double tap): the system MUST ignore any such trigger received while a save for that capture is already in flight, so at most one entry is ever created per confirmed capture.
106	- **FR-007**: For the audio and photo modalities, confirming Save MUST automatically produce the text content the entry requires — via on-device transcription for audio and backend text recognition for photo — before the entry is created, shown to the user only as a plain, generic loading indicator while it happens; this unit MUST NOT present a dedicated multi-state screen (distinct "processing", "transcribed"/"recognized", or "error" states with their own styling), an editable review step for the recognized text, or modality-specific retry affordances such as "Tentar novamente" or "Salvar só a foto" — those are reserved for a later unit.
107	- **FR-008**: If a capture is abandoned before Save is confirmed — the modal is closed, the user navigates away, a recording is stopped without saving, or an in-progress camera/gallery selection is cancelled — the system MUST NOT create any entry, partial or empty, for that capture.
108	- **FR-009**: If recognizing audio or photo content fails, or the entry-creation call itself fails, when Save is attempted, the system MUST NOT create a partial or placeholder entry; it MUST show a clear failure indication and let the user retry the same captured audio or image without requiring a fresh recording or photo, as long as that captured content is still held locally for the current app session (this guarantee does not survive the app process being killed — see Edge Cases).
109	- **FR-010**: Creating an entry MUST require network connectivity; when the device is offline, the system MUST block the Save action with a clear message rather than attempting a write that cannot succeed.
110	- **FR-011**: On a successful Save, the Insertion Modal MUST close and return the user to Home/Chat with no other visible change to that screen (the prototype defines no confirmation screen or toast for this flow); the newly created entry MUST be reflected only in the app's local entries store/cache, available for later units (e.g., Meus Registros, RF07) to read.
111	- **FR-012**: This unit MUST NOT implement any functional behavior belonging to later-delivered requirements (RF02's dedicated recognition-state screens beyond the minimal loading indicator in FR-007, and the full behavior of RF04, RF05, RF06, RF07, RF08, RF09, RF10), nor any extension feature (manual tags/categories, action plans, persona selection).
112	- **FR-013**: This unit MUST NOT modify the backend, its API contract, or its configuration in any way.
113	
114	### Key Entities
115	
116	- **Journal Entry**: A persisted record with text content, an origin (`manual`, `audio`, or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time; structurally identical regardless of which modality produced it, and immutable once created.
117	- **Capture Session**: Ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the Insertion Modal is open — which tab is active, any in-progress recording or selected image, and text recognized but not yet saved. It is entirely discarded if the capture is abandoned, and never itself becomes a persisted entry.
118	
119	## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*
120	
121	### Measurable Outcomes
122	
123	- **SC-001**: 100% of successfully saved captures, across all three modalities, produce a journal entry that is structurally identical to the others (differing only in its content and origin) — none is treated as a special case downstream.
124	- **SC-002**: 100% of abandoned captures (modal closed, navigation away, in-progress recording stopped without saving, or picker cancelled) leave zero entries behind.
125	- **SC-003**: Users can go from tapping "+" to a newly saved text entry in well under 15 seconds of their own interaction time (typing and one tap), with no required intermediate screens.
126	- **SC-004**: A failure recognizing or saving audio or photo content never forces the user to redo the recording or recapture the photo while that captured content is still available — 0% of such failures result in lost source material.
127	- **SC-005**: 100% of save attempts made while offline are blocked with a clear message before any network call is attempted.
128	
129	## Assumptions
130	
131	- The "Áudio" tab begins recording automatically as soon as it becomes the active tab (matching the prototype, which shows "Gravando" as that tab's default state), requesting microphone permission at that point if not already granted.
132	- Audio transcription runs on-device (per the project's fixed technology stack) and photo text recognition runs via the backend's existing OCR endpoint (which does not persist the image); invoking both is a use of already-established, fixed stack pieces rather than new functionality reserved for RF02 — only RF02's dedicated multi-state UI, editable review, and modality-specific retry/fallback actions are deferred, per the resolved Clarification above.
133	- No maximum audio recording duration is defined by the input documents; this unit imposes none beyond ordinary device/storage limits.
134	- Because entries cannot be edited or deleted after creation, recognition (transcription or OCR) must complete successfully before an entry is created for audio or photo — there is no later correction step in this unit.
135	- Saving is blocked while offline following the same cloud-only, no-offline-writes pattern already established elsewhere in the product (chat, search); this unit does not introduce an offline queue.
136	- "Salvar" being disabled while a save is already in flight (FR-006) is the mechanism satisfying that requirement's idempotency clause, mirroring the explicit callout RF10's own requirements.md text gives this same safeguard.
137	- Switching tabs mid-recording discards the in-progress recording, since the prototype documentation leaves this behavior undefined and no partial entry may survive regardless.

# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)

**Created**: 2026-10-12

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."

## Clarifications

### Session 2026-10-12

- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1)

A user wants to quickly note something in words. They tap "+" on Home/Chat, the Insertion Modal opens on its "Texto" tab, they write freely in the text field, and tap "Salvar". The modal closes and the note now exists as one of their journal entries.

**Why this priority**: The simplest and fully self-contained of the three capture paths — it has no dependency on recognition of any kind, so it is the first thing that must work end to end.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by tapping "+", typing text into the Texto tab, tapping "Salvar", and confirming a new entry with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** Home/Chat is open, **When** the user taps "+", **Then** the Insertion Modal opens as an overlay on top of Home/Chat (which stays in place underneath), defaulted to the "Texto" tab with an empty field.
2. **Given** the Texto tab with text typed into the field, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** a new journal entry is created with that text as its content and origin "manual", and the modal closes, returning to Home/Chat.
3. **Given** the Texto tab with an empty field, **When** the user looks at "Salvar", **Then** the action is unavailable (disabled), so an empty entry can never be created.

---

### User Story 2 - Recording a journal entry as audio (Priority: P1)

A user prefers to speak rather than type. They tap "+", switch to the "Áudio" tab, and recording begins with a visible waveform and timer. They tap stop, and after a brief moment the spoken content is saved as a journal entry just like a written one.

**Why this priority**: Voice capture is one of the two microphone/camera-dependent paths and, together with Story 1, establishes that every modality converges on the same entry format — the central acceptance criterion of this unit.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by opening the Áudio tab, recording a short spoken note, stopping the recording, confirming Save completes, and confirming a new entry exists with origin "audio" and text content derived from what was spoken.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Áudio" tab, **Then** recording starts immediately, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running mm:ss timer.
2. **Given** an active recording, **When** the user taps stop, **Then** the recording ends and the system automatically transcribes it and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "audio" and the transcribed text as its content.

### User Story 3 - Capturing a journal entry from a photo (Priority: P2)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** the Insertion Modal is open, **When** the user switches to the "Foto" tab, **Then** two options are shown — "Câmera" and "Galeria" — with no image selected yet.
2. **Given** the user picks "Câmera" or "Galeria" and supplies an image, **When** that image is provided, **Then** the system automatically extracts its text and completes the save as part of confirming the capture, producing one new entry with origin "photo" and the recognized text as its content.
3. **Given** a completed photo capture that is being recognized and saved, **When** that processing is underway, **Then** the user sees a plain loading indicator (not a detailed multi-state screen) until it finishes.
4. **Given** text recognition or the save itself fails, **When** that happens, **Then** no entry is created, a clear failure message is shown, and the user can retry without having to recapture the image, as long as it is still held locally.

---

### User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)

A user starts writing, recording, or photographing, changes their mind, and backs out. Nothing about that attempt is saved anywhere.

**Why this priority**: A safety property that applies across all three modalities rather than a feature of its own; depends on Stories 1–3 already existing to have something to abandon.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by starting each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the camera/gallery picker) and closing the modal or navigating away before tapping Salvar, then confirming no new entry was created in any case.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** partially typed text in the Texto tab, **When** the user closes the modal without tapping "Salvar", **Then** no entry is created and the draft text is discarded.
2. **Given** an in-progress audio recording, **When** the user closes the modal or stops without confirming save, **Then** no entry is created and no partially-recorded audio is persisted as an entry.
3. **Given** the Foto tab's camera/gallery picker is open, **When** the user cancels it without completing a capture, **Then** no entry is created.

---

### Edge Cases

- Microphone or camera permission is denied at the OS level: the respective tab shows an explanatory message in place of the recording/capture controls, instead of silently failing or crashing.
- The user switches tabs while a recording is in progress: the in-progress recording is discarded (same outcome as closing the modal), since no partial entry may survive regardless of which tab is active afterward.
- The app is backgrounded or killed while a capture is in progress and unsaved, **or while it is stopped/captured and awaiting retry after a recognition or save failure**: nothing is lost that mattered, because nothing was persisted yet — the captured audio/image and any pending retry state exist only in memory for the current app session. On return (after a mere backgrounding, the modal resumes normally; after a kill, the modal reopens to its default empty state), and if the content was lost to a process kill, the user must recapture rather than retry.
- Transcription or OCR succeeds technically but returns no usable text (e.g., silence, a blank or illegible image): Save fails with a clear message rather than creating an empty or near-empty entry. - The user double-taps "Salvar": only one entry is ever created per confirmed capture, never duplicates.

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-001**: The system MUST provide an Insertion Modal, opened by the "+" button on Home/Chat, shown as an overlay above Home/Chat (with a darkened scrim) without discarding or navigating away from Home/Chat's state underneath.
- **FR-002**: The Insertion Modal MUST present exactly three capture modes as tabs — "Texto", "Áudio", "Foto" — with the active tab visually distinguished, and MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened.
- **FR-003**: The "Texto" tab MUST provide a free multiline text field and a "Salvar" action that is unavailable while the field is empty.
- **FR-004**: The "Áudio" tab MUST start real-time audio recording as soon as it becomes active, showing a stop control, an animated waveform, and a running timer, matching the "Gravando" state.
- **FR-005**: The "Foto" tab MUST offer the user a choice between the device camera and the photo gallery to supply a single image, matching the "Captura" state.

- **FR-013**: This unit MUST NOT modify the backend, its API contract, or its configuration in any way.

### Key Entities

- **Journal Entry**: A persisted record with text content, an origin (`manual`, `audio`, or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time; structurally identical regardless of which modality produced it, and immutable once created.

It is entirely discarded if the capture is abandoned, and never itself becomes a persisted entry.

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

14	RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
15	a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
16	tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,

26	R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.

28	## Technical Context
29	
30	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
31	F000/RF03, no new pin needed.
32

## Summary

230	
231	### Phase Dependencies
232	
233	- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
234	- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup (T004's bundled model asset is read by US2's T034) — BLOCKS all user stories.
235	- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
236	  - US1 (P1) should be done first — it is the only story with no recognition dependency, and it is
237	    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
238	    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
239	  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/
240	    `insertion_modal_state.dart`/`insertion_modal_page.dart` files US1 touches (T041/T059 both
241	    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
242	    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently
243	    testable once done, per spec.md's own priority ordering (P1 before P2).
244	  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
245	    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).
246	- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

248	### Within Each User Story
249	
250	- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
251	  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
252	  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
253	- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
254	  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
255	  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
256	- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

280	Task: "Create CaptureTab enum + InsertionModalEvent base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart"
281	Task: "Create InsertionModalState base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart"
282	```

285	
286	```bash
287	Task: "Create RecognitionFailure sealed type in lib/features/capture/domain/entities/recognition_failure.dart"
288	Task: "Create AudioCaptureRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart"
289	Task: "Create AudioTranscriptionRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart"
290	```
291	
292	---

294	## Implementation Strategy
295	
296	### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)
297	
298	1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
299	2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
300	3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
301	4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
302	   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.
303	
304	### Incremental Delivery
305	
306	1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
307	2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
308	3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
309	   criterion, SC-001).
310	4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
311	   structurally identical.
312	5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
313	6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.
314	
315	---
316	
317	## Notes
318	
319	- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
320	  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
321	  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
322	  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/
323	  insertion-modal-bloc.md chose (mirroring RF03's `VaultBloc`), not a same-file conflict to avoid.
324	- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
325	  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code
326	  (research.md R7). `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()`, by contrast, is a real network call
327	  and reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged.
328	- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, RF02's
329	  (not-yet-built) dedicated recognition-state screens, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all

331	- `OcrResult.confidence` is carried through the full pipeline (T049, T055) but never branched on
332	  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's

# Tasks: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md (all present)

**Tests**: Included. The constitution's RNF07 (`lib/**/domain/**` ≥80% coverage) and RNF09
(15/15 write-endpoint failure scenarios via `mocktail`) gates apply to this unit, and
quickstart.md's "Automated checks" section explicitly names the domain/data tests this unit's
coverage depends on — so test tasks are generated alongside implementation, matching
F000/RF03's existing `bloc_test`/`mocktail` style exactly.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (US1–US4, spec.md priorities P1/P1/P2/P3). Per
contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md, all four stories share one page/bloc
(`InsertionModalPage`/`InsertionModalBloc`) by deliberate design (research.md R6) — "independent"
here means each story's acceptance scenarios can be exercised and automated-tested on their own
once Foundational is done, not that each story gets its own screen or bloc. `entries/` (research.md
R8) is built once in Foundational because all three capture modalities (US1–US3) depend on
`CreateEntryUseCase` to persist their result.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1 (text entry), US2 (audio entry), US3 (photo entry), US4 (abandoning a capture
  leaves nothing behind)

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter project (F000/RF03's existing `lib/`, `test/`) — see plan.md Project Structure. All
new files live under `lib/features/entries/`, `lib/features/capture/`, `test/features/entries/`,
`test/features/capture/`, and one new `lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`; one existing
F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`) and the shared `service_locator.dart`/`pubspec.yaml`/iOS
project files are touched at documented extension points.

---

## Phase 1: Setup

**Purpose**: Dependencies and native-project changes every later task needs.

- [X] T001 Add `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, `connectivity_plus`, and `path_provider` to `pubspec.yaml` dependencies (research.md R1–R5), then run `fvm flutter pub get`

## Phase 6: User Story 4 - Abandoning a capture leaves nothing behind (Priority: P3)

**Goal**: Closing the modal, navigating away, stopping a recording without saving, or cancelling
the photo picker — in any tab, at any point before Save is confirmed — leaves zero entries behind.

**Independent Test**: Start each modality (typing a partial note, starting a recording, opening the
camera/gallery picker) and close the modal or navigate away before tapping Salvar; confirm no new
entry was created in any case.

### Implementation for User Story 4

- [X] T066 [P] [US4] Extend `InsertionModalBloc` tests in `insertion_modal_bloc_test.dart` with abandonment scenarios across all three modalities: partially typed `InsertionModalTexto` + `ModalClosed` → no `CreateEntryUseCase` call, draft discarded; `ModalClosed` during `InsertionModalAudioRecording` → `discard()` called, no entry; `PhotoSourceSelected` cancelled or `ModalClosed` during `InsertionModalFotoCaptura` → no entry; re-confirm `TabSelected(<other>)` mid-recording (covered by T047) also produces zero entries — SC-002's "100% of abandoned captures... leave zero entries behind" — depends on T065
- [X] T067 [US4] Confirm `InsertionModalPage`'s `showModalBottomSheet` call (wired in T027) constructs a brand-new `BlocProvider<InsertionModalBloc>` on every open, so no tab selection, draft text, or sub-state survives a close-then-reopen cycle ("MUST reset every tab to its initial, empty state each time the modal is freshly opened" — FR-002) — depends on T027, T065

**Checkpoint**: All four user stories are independently functional.

---

## Phase 7: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns

**Purpose**: The constitution/quickstart gates that span every story above.

---

## Phase 8: Convergence

- [X] T072 Replace the three hardcoded pixel literals in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/audio_waveform.dart` (`EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2)`, `width: 4`, `height: 8 + normalized * 32`) with the existing `DesignTokens.spacingXs`/`spacingSm`/`spacingXl` constants (values 4/8/32 already defined in `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`) per Constitution Principle IV (contradicts)

---

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup (T004's bundled model asset is read by US2's T034) — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–6)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) should be done first — it is the only story with no recognition dependency, and it is
    the one that first registers `InsertionModalBloc` in DI (T024) and adds the real "+" button
    (T027), which US2/US3 build on.
  - US2 (P1) and US3 (P2) each extend the same `InsertionModalBloc`/`insertion_modal_event.dart`/
    `insertion_modal_state.dart`/`insertion_modal_page.dart` files US1 touches (T041/T059 both
    extend the bloc's constructor; T045/T062 both extend the page's `BlocBuilder` switch) — doing
    them in priority order (US2 before US3) avoids rework, even though each is independently
    testable once done, per spec.md's own priority ordering (P1 before P2).
  - US4 (P3) depends on US2's and US3's `*Recording`/`*Saving`/`*Captura` states already existing
    to have something to abandon (T065 extends the same `ModalClosed` handler T017 stubbed).
- **Polish (Phase 7)**: Depends on all four stories being complete.

### Within Each User Story

- Domain entities/enums before repository interfaces; repository interfaces before data sources
  and usecases; usecases before bloc wiring; bloc wiring before the tab-view widget that reads it;
  DI registration before the "+"/tab-selection path that resolves the bloc from `get_it`.
- Tests are written alongside (and can be run immediately after) each implementation task, per the
  file pairing above, rather than strictly before — this project's F000/RF03 precedent write/extend
  the same test file across a story's tasks rather than one file per task.
- Story complete (domain + data + bloc + widget + tests) before moving to the next priority.

### Parallel Opportunities

- T002, T004 (Setup) in parallel with T001/T003 once each is independently actionable.
- T005, T013 (entities/connectivity) in parallel within Foundational; T015/T016/T018 (event/state/
  tab-bar skeletons) in parallel with each other and with the `entries` feature tasks.
- T008, T010, T012 (test files) can be written in parallel with each other once their respective
  implementation task lands.
- T020/T021 (US1 bloc event/state additions) in parallel with T022/T023 (US1 usecase + its test) —
  different files, both depend only on Foundational.
- T029/T030/T031 (US2 domain types) in parallel with each other; T048/T049 (US3 domain types) in
  parallel with each other.
- T036/T038 and T054/T056 (test files) in parallel with their respective sibling implementation
  task's dependents once that task lands.

---

## Parallel Example: Foundational Phase

```bash
# Launch independent entity/interface files together:
Task: "Create Entry entity + enums in lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart"
Task: "Create ConnectivityChecker in lib/core/network/connectivity_checker.dart"
Task: "Create CaptureTab enum + InsertionModalEvent base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_event.dart"
Task: "Create InsertionModalState base in lib/features/capture/presentation/bloc/insertion_modal_state.dart"
```

## Parallel Example: User Story 2 domain layer

```bash
Task: "Create RecognitionFailure sealed type in lib/features/capture/domain/entities/recognition_failure.dart"
Task: "Create AudioCaptureRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_capture_repository.dart"
Task: "Create AudioTranscriptionRepository interface in lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/audio_transcription_repository.dart"
```

---

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (CRITICAL — blocks all stories).
3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1.
4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: tap "+", type text, tap "Salvar" — a new "manual" entry exists and the
   modal closes back to Home/Chat with no other visible change.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Setup + Foundational → the `entries` feature and modal shell exist (Texto-only skeleton).
2. Add US1 → text capture works end to end; the "+" button exists for the first time.
3. Add US2 → audio capture converges on the same entry format as text (the central acceptance
   criterion, SC-001).
4. Add US3 → photo capture converges on the same entry format too; all three modalities proven
   structurally identical.
5. Add US4 → the safety property that no modality ever leaves a partial/empty entry behind.
6. Polish → RNF06/07 gates + quickstart's full manual pass.

---

## Notes

- `insertion_modal_bloc.dart`, `insertion_modal_event.dart`, `insertion_modal_state.dart`, and
  `insertion_modal_page.dart` are each touched by multiple story phases (T017/T025/T041/T059/T065
  for the bloc; T015/T020/T040/T058 for events; T016/T021/T039/T057 for states; T019/T027/T045/T062
  for the page) — this is the deliberate single-screen/single-bloc shape contracts/
  insertion-modal-bloc.md chose (mirroring RF03's `VaultBloc`), not a same-file conflict to avoid.
- `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`,
  **not** `Either<Failure, T>` — it has no network call and no corresponding backend code
  (research.md R7). `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()`, by contrast, is a real network call
  and reuses the existing `Failure` hierarchy unchanged.
- No task in this list touches `docs/input/`, `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `.env`, RF02's
  (not-yet-built) dedicated recognition-state screens, or any of RF04–RF10's behavior — all
  explicitly out of scope (FR-012, FR-013).
- `OcrResult.confidence` is carried through the full pipeline (T049, T055) but never branched on
  anywhere, including in the UI (T061) — confidence-based quality gating is explicitly RF02's
  concern (Clarification 3).

content.content:
50	text runs on-device via `whisper_ggml`; audio content MUST NEVER be sent to
51	the backend. The shipping platform is iOS. Choices not fixed here — routing,
52	HTTP client, local cache, dependency injection, secure storage, biometrics,
53	and charting — are open implementation decisions.
54	
55	Rationale: a single, non-negotiable stack removes a whole category of
56	architectural debate and keeps the codebase consistent across features
57	built by different contributors or at different times.
58	
59	### III. Backend Boundary — Frozen Backend, No Direct AI Calls
60	The backend is already built and frozen. The app consumes it strictly as
61	documented in `docs/input/backend/`, including its API contract
62	(`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`); the app MUST NOT change the
63	backend, its API contract, or its configuration. All AI features, including
64	semantic search, are provided exclusively by the backend — the app MUST
65	NEVER call an AI provider directly. Configuration and credentials come from
66	a project-root `.env` with exactly two variables: `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL` and
67	`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`. Every call to `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>` MUST
68	carry the header `apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>`. The `Authorization: Bearer`
69	header carries `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` for operations that need no user session
70	(sign-up, login, refresh) and the user's access token for every operation
71	marked `bearerAuth` in the OpenAPI contract. `.env` and any credential MUST
72	NEVER be committed.
73	
74	Rationale: the backend and its AI integrations are out of this project's
75	scope and already relied upon elsewhere; treating them as an immutable,
76	narrowly-accessed contract prevents scope creep and accidental coupling or
77	credential leakage.
78	
79	### IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity
80	`lib/core/design_tokens.dart` is the single source of colors, typography,
81	spacing, and radii. No visual value MAY be hardcoded anywhere else. The UI
82	MUST be faithful to `docs/input/prototype/`. UI text MUST be in Portuguese,
83	exactly as written in the prototype; code identifiers, comments, and project
84	documentation MUST be in English.
85	
86	Rationale: a single token source makes visual fidelity (RNF08) mechanically
87	checkable, and separating UI language (Portuguese, matching the frozen
88	prototype) from code language (English) keeps the codebase reviewable while
89	preserving the product's voice.
90	
91	### V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention
92	Code MUST follow the folder convention:
93	```
94	lib/
95	  core/
96	  features/
97	    <feature>/
98	      data/
99	      domain/
100	      presentation/
101	```
102	The domain layer MUST comply with RNF06: zero layer violations — it MUST
103	NOT import `package:flutter` nor any class from a feature's `data/` layer.
104	
105	Rationale: a fixed, enforced folder shape and a flutter/data-free domain
106	layer make the domain independently testable and keep business rules
107	portable regardless of UI or persistence choices.
108	
109	## Quality Standards (RNF01–RNF09)
110	
111	These targets from `docs/input/requirements.md` are binding quality gates:
112	
113	- **RNF01 — Interaction latency**: a local action MUST be reflected in the
114	  UI in under 100 ms; any network call taking longer than 300 ms MUST show a
115	  loading indicator.
116	- **RNF02 — PII stripping**: performed backend-side via Claude Haiku 4.5
117	  with a structured prompt / tool use, not a dedicated NER model; the app
118	  implements no PII-detection logic of its own.
119	- **RNF03 — Zero data retention**: a backend-side policy; the app MUST NOT
120	  introduce its own retention beyond what the backend requires.
121	- **RNF04 — Row Level Security (RLS)**: enforced backend-side; the app MUST
122	  assume RLS is authoritative and MUST NEVER attempt to bypass it.
123	- **RNF05 — Hard delete of account and data (LGPD)**: the app MUST expose
124	  the account-deletion flow (`DELETE /account`) from Settings.
125	- **RNF06 — Zero layer violations**: see Principle V; 0 violations is the
126	  target.
127	- **RNF07 — Domain test coverage**: `lib/**/domain/**` MUST reach at least
128	  80% test coverage.
129	- **RNF08 — Visual fidelity**: every screen MUST match the prototype's
130	  color, typography, and spacing, with 0 hardcoded visual values outside
131	  `design_tokens.dart`.
132	- **RNF09 — Consistent network-error handling**: every repository MUST use
133	  the `Either<Failure, T>` pattern via `fpdart`; every write endpoint (5
134	  endpoints) MUST handle timeout, malformed response, and no-connection
135	  failures, each covered by `mocktail` tests (15 of 15 scenarios).
136	
137	## Scope & Delivery Boundaries
138	
139	- Functional requirements MUST be implemented in the delivery order given in
140	  `docs/input/requirements.md`.
141	- Extension features (section 2 of `requirements.md`) are explicitly out of
142	  scope and MUST NOT be implemented beyond an optional placeholder menu
143	  entry.
144	- The following actions are prohibited in this repository:
145	  - Changing the backend, its API contract, or its configuration.
146	  - Calling AI providers directly from the app.
147	  - Writing visual values (colors, font sizes, spacing, radii) outside
148	    `design_tokens.dart`.
149	  - Implementing extension features.
150	  - Committing `.env` or any credential.
151	  - Editing files under `docs/input/`.
152	
153	## Governance
154

file.content:
text runs on-device via `whisper_ggml`; audio content MUST NEVER be sent to
the backend. The shipping platform is iOS. Choices not fixed here — routing,
HTTP client, local cache, dependency injection, secure storage, biometrics,
and charting — are open implementation decisions.

Rationale: a single, non-negotiable stack removes a whole category of
architectural debate and keeps the codebase consistent across features
built by different contributors or at different times.

### III. Backend Boundary — Frozen Backend, No Direct AI Calls
The backend is already built and frozen. The app consumes it strictly as
documented in `docs/input/backend/`, including its API contract
(`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`); the app MUST NOT change the
backend, its API contract, or its configuration. All AI features, including
semantic search, are provided exclusively by the backend — the app MUST
NEVER call an AI provider directly. Configuration and credentials come from
a project-root `.env` with exactly two variables: `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL` and
`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`. Every call to `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>` MUST
carry the header `apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>`. The `Authorization: Bearer`
header carries `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` for operations that need no user session
(sign-up, login, refresh) and the user's access token for every operation
marked `bearerAuth` in the OpenAPI contract. `.env` and any credential MUST
NEVER be committed.

Rationale: the backend and its AI integrations are out of this project's
scope and already relied upon elsewhere; treating them as an immutable,
narrowly-accessed contract prevents scope creep and accidental coupling or
credential leakage.

### IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity
`lib/core/design_tokens.dart` is the single source of colors, typography,
spacing, and radii. No visual value MAY be hardcoded anywhere else. The UI
MUST be faithful to `docs/input/prototype/`. UI text MUST be in Portuguese,
exactly as written in the prototype; code identifiers, comments, and project
documentation MUST be in English.

Rationale: a single token source makes visual fidelity (RNF08) mechanically
checkable, and separating UI language (Portuguese, matching the frozen
prototype) from code language (English) keeps the codebase reviewable while
preserving the product's voice.

### V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention
Code MUST follow the folder convention:
```
lib/
  core/
  features/
    <feature>/
      data/
      domain/
      presentation/
```
The domain layer MUST comply with RNF06: zero layer violations — it MUST
NOT import `package:flutter` nor any class from a feature's `data/` layer.

Rationale: a fixed, enforced folder shape and a flutter/data-free domain
layer make the domain independently testable and keep business rules
portable regardless of UI or persistence choices.

## Quality Standards (RNF01–RNF09)

These targets from `docs/input/requirements.md` are binding quality gates:

- **RNF01 — Interaction latency**: a local action MUST be reflected in the
  UI in under 100 ms; any network call taking longer than 300 ms MUST show a
  loading indicator.
- **RNF02 — PII stripping**: performed backend-side via Claude Haiku 4.5
  with a structured prompt / tool use, not a dedicated NER model; the app
  implements no PII-detection logic of its own.
- **RNF03 — Zero data retention**: a backend-side policy; the app MUST NOT
  introduce its own retention beyond what the backend requires.
- **RNF04 — Row Level Security (RLS)**: enforced backend-side; the app MUST
  assume RLS is authoritative and MUST NEVER attempt to bypass it.
- **RNF05 — Hard delete of account and data (LGPD)**: the app MUST expose
  the account-deletion flow (`DELETE /account`) from Settings.
- **RNF06 — Zero layer violations**: see Principle V; 0 violations is the
  target.
- **RNF07 — Domain test coverage**: `lib/**/domain/**` MUST reach at least
  80% test coverage.
- **RNF08 — Visual fidelity**: every screen MUST match the prototype's
  color, typography, and spacing, with 0 hardcoded visual values outside
  `design_tokens.dart`.
- **RNF09 — Consistent network-error handling**: every repository MUST use
  the `Either<Failure, T>` pattern via `fpdart`; every write endpoint (5
  endpoints) MUST handle timeout, malformed response, and no-connection
  failures, each covered by `mocktail` tests (15 of 15 scenarios).

## Scope & Delivery Boundaries

- Functional requirements MUST be implemented in the delivery order given in
  `docs/input/requirements.md`.
- Extension features (section 2 of `requirements.md`) are explicitly out of
  scope and MUST NOT be implemented beyond an optional placeholder menu
  entry.
- The following actions are prohibited in this repository:
  - Changing the backend, its API contract, or its configuration.
  - Calling AI providers directly from the app.
  - Writing visual values (colors, font sizes, spacing, radii) outside
    `design_tokens.dart`.
  - Implementing extension features.
  - Committing `.env` or any credential.
  - Editing files under `docs/input/`.

## Governance

This constitution supersedes any conflicting practice, template, or
instruction used in this repository. Every plan, spec, task list, and
review MUST verify compliance with these principles before work is
considered done; any deviation MUST be justified in writing in the relevant
artifact (plan or PR description) or the work MUST be rejected.

**Amendment procedure**: amendments are proposed by editing this file,
describing the change and rationale, and are adopted once the project owner
accepts the change (commit to this file constitutes adoption in this
single-maintainer project). Each amendment MUST update the Sync Impact
Report at the top of this file and the version/date line below.

**Versioning policy** (semantic versioning for this document):
- **MAJOR** — backward-incompatible governance or principle removal/
  redefinition.
- **MINOR** — a new principle or section added, or materially expanded
  guidance.
- **PATCH** — wording clarifications, typo fixes, non-semantic refinements.

**Compliance review**: any change to `lib/` MUST be checked against the
Core Principles and Quality Standards above before merge; violations of
RNF06–RNF09 in particular are release blockers.

content.content:
# Data Model: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1, 6.2, 9 (data model reference), §13, and
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas. This unit introduces
one new backend-shaped entity (`Entry`, read from a contract the backend already defines — no
schema change) and one ephemeral, device-only, non-persisted "entity" (Capture Session, modeled as
presentation state, not a domain type — see research.md R8 for why `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`
live in a new `entries` feature, separate from `capture`).

## Entry (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`)

The full shape of `POST /entries`' response — every field below is `required` in the OpenAPI
schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` (uuid) | Server-assigned. |
| `content` | `String` | 1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty (FR-003/Edge Cases — never an empty/near-empty entry). |
| `source` | `EntrySource` | `manual` \| `audio` \| `photo` for this unit (see below — `chat` is RF10's addition). |
| `chatMessageId` | `String?` (uuid) | Always `null` for every entry this unit creates. |
| `occurredAt` | `DateTime` | Server-assigned; this unit never sends its own value in the request. |
| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |

```dart
enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }

class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
```

**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).

## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime
}
```

- `create()` posts to `entries-create` via the existing, unmodified `ApiClient`/`Failure` hierarchy
  — no new `Failure` subtype (every backend error this call can realistically return —
  `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PII_CHECK_FAILED`, `EMBEDDING_FAILED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`,
  `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `RATE_LIMITED` — already exists in `core/network/failure.dart`).
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl` is registered as a `get_it` `lazySingleton` (the same pattern
  `VaultRepository` uses for its own in-memory, process-lifetime state — RF03 research.md R3) so
  `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens/closes without a local database. On a successful
  `create()`, the returned `Entry` is appended to this in-memory list before the `Either` is
  returned to the caller. Nothing in this unit ever *reads* `cachedEntries` back out for display —
  it exists purely so RF07 (the first unit that reads entries for a screen) has something to read
  from day one, per FR-011's explicit forward reference to "Meus Registros, RF07."

## `CreateEntryUseCase` (`lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart`)

```dart
class CreateEntryUseCase {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) =>
      repository.create(content: content, source: source);
}
```

The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.

## Capture Session (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)

Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:

| Held where | What | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |

No field here is ever written to disk or to the backend as its own record — only a *successful*
recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.

## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)

```
Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab

[Texto tab]
  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)

[Áudio tab — recording starts the instant the tab becomes active, FR-004]
  TabSelected(audio)
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
  AudioStopRequested
    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
            Left(EmptyRecognitionResult()) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)   (Edge Cases: silence — the repository itself guarantees this, never Right(''))
            Left(TranscriptionError())     -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)     (FR-009)
